events.name: MVP Court Pass (CHECK IN BY 2:30pm)
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-Court Access from 1:30PM - 2PM
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

events.info: HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS: RIVALRY TOUR Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Stranahan Theatre Box Office hours are as follows: Monday - Friday 9:00am-5:00pm Saturady 9:00am-1:00pm Sunday the theatre is open only if there is an event.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts Cash, Check, Visa, Mastercard, and Discover for events at the Stranahan. The Box Office is also a Ticketmaster location. For tickets to non-Stranahan events the Box Office accepts cash and credit cards only.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available beginning 2 hours prior to showtime. Customer needs ID, confirmation number and credit card if possible.

venues.parkingDetail: Free parking is available around the Theatre.

generalInfo.generalRule: Recording devices are never allowed. Cameras are generally not allowed, but on rare occasion, may be permitted. There is NO smoking.
generalInfo.childRule: The standard rule is that children who have reached their 2nd birthday need a ticket to enter. Children under 2 must sit on adults lap. Every show is different please check with Ticket Office.
